snippet.title: Canvas Street | Frosty Games Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

Get in on the ground floor with a first look at the blueprints for Canvas Street’s architecture and design gameplay! In this game from Leura Smith and Katsumi Yoshida, the player will design houses for a variety of different clients, playing through the architectural process one step at a time. What you’re seeing is still in the early stages of development, but should give you an idea of the finished (and fully furnished) result.

Find more games made in Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand on our Steam event page here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45423962/sale/FrostyGamesCelebration
